title: Crosscap resurgence and Riemann--Hilbert problems for orientifolded conifolds
summary: We study the crosscap contribution to the large-$N$ SO/Sp free energy of the orientifolded conifold by comparing its formal expansion with Faddeev's quantum dilogarithm. This determines its Borel transform, sectorial sums, Stokes jumps, and accumulation limits; in the convergent chamber, these limits combine with resolved-conifold summation to recover the full orientifold free energy.
